book.name: 1 Corinth
book.title: Paul Fus Letta Ta Dem Een Corinth

content: Mus Dohn Cyaa Ya Christian Broda ta Court
Ef one ob oona got aught ginst ya Christian broda, mus dohn cyaa um ta court ta de jedge wa ain know God. Stead ob dat, leh God people handle de case.
Ain oona know dat de time da come wen God people gwine jedge de whole wol? So den, ef oona gwine jedge de whole wol, fa sho, oona able fa jedge de leetle case yah.
Ain oona know dat we gwine jedge angel? Well den, ef we gwine jedge angel, we oughta be way mo able fa jedge dem case een dis life yah!
So ef oona haffa hab susha case, oona ain gwine tek um fa be jedge front ob people dat ain got no standin een de choch, ainty?
A say dis fa mek oona shame! Oona ain gwine tell me dat dey ain none mongst oona dat got sense fa jedge de case wen oona Christian bredren got aught ginst one noda.
Stead ob leh God people handle de case, bredren da tek one noda an cyaa um ta court. E da leh dem wa ain bleebe God jedge de case fa um!
Wen oona cyaa um ta court fa settle aught mongst oonasef, dat show oona ain da waak right wid God tall. Ain e betta fa leh oda people do ya bad? Ain e betta fa leh um tek ya propaty?
Stead ob dat, oona da do oona Christian broda bad. Oona da tek one noda propaty. Oona da do dis ting yah ta oona own Christian bredren!

Ain oona know dat none ob dem wa lib wickity life ain gwine lib weh God da rule. Mus dohn fool oonasef. People wa da lib loose life, dem wa da woshup idol dem, dem people wa ron roun on dey husban or dey wife, an dem man wa sleep wid oda man, dey ain gwine lib weh God da rule.
People wa got light han, dem wid de long eye, dem wa dronka, dem wa da ron dey mout da taak bad bout oda people, an dem wa da tief, ain none ob dem gwine lib weh God da rule needa.

Some ob oona nyuse fa be like dem people yah. Bot een de name ob de Lawd Jedus Christ an een de Sperit ob we God, oona sin done been wash way. Oona been set side fa be God own people. Ebryting done been mek right tween oona an God.
Nyuse Oona Body fa God Glory

People say, “A free fa do wasoneba A wahn. Ain no law fa stop me.” Bot ain all ting wa ya kin do, ton out fa be good fa ya. A kin say, “A free fa do wasoneba A wahn. Ain no law fa stop me.” Bot A ain gwine leh nottin wa A do mek me a slabe, so dat A cyahn stop do um.

Oda people kin say, “Food fa de belly, an de belly fa food.” Dat true, bot God gwine stroy all two ob dem. De Lawd ain mek people body fa lib loose life. E mek people body so dat dey kin saab um. An de Lawd, e de one wa gii people ebryting wa good fa dey body.
Wid e powa God done mek de Lawd git op fom mongst de dead people an lib gin. An e powa gwine mek we lib gin too.
Fa true, oona know dat oona body dem ebry one a paat ob Christ body, ain dat so? A gwine tek one paat ob Christ body an mek um paat ob de body ob a loose ooman? Dat mus dohn happen!
Oona know dat wen a man jine e body ta a loose ooman, e an de ooman all one body, ainty? Dey write een God Book say, “De two ob um, wen dey lay down wid one noda, gwine be one body.”
Bot wen people bleebe an jine deysef ta de Lawd, den dey one sperit wid de Lawd.
Oona mus dohn lib loose life. All de oda sin dat people do, dey ain go ginst dey own body. Bot wen people lib loose life, dey da sin ginst dey own body.
Ain oona know dat oona body God House, weh de Holy Sperit da lib dey dey eenside oona? Oona ain blongst ta oona own sef. Oona blongst ta God.
God done pay de price fa oona. So den, oona oughta nyuse oona body fa gii hona ta God.
